title: Shipped workflow and template assets

claims.statement: The shipped program workflow composes decomposition, plan registration/risk/schedule/dispatch stages; ai-sdlc and plan-resume are separate workflow definitions.
Template discovery loads files from configured glob patterns and registers parsed front matter/body; user packs use prefix-based selection.
Plugin example demonstrates registration through definePlugin; production startup imports configured ESM modules before graph validation.
The JEV example opts into an evaluation plugin and shadow workflow explicitly; it is not a global evaluator enabled by default.

limits: Baseline inspected workflow YAML as executable definitions and template discovery/frontmatter identifiers; natural-language template prose was deferred to the documentation phase.
